# OptimoRoute

OptimoRoute is an online route optimization and planning solution for delivery, logistics, and field service companies.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/optimoroute/.

## Actions

- **Get Drivers** (read-only): Retrieve all drivers in the system.
- **Get Planned Routes** (read-only): Retrieve all planned routes for a given date.
